svg.desc: Recorded load in ton-force versus elapsed hours since baseline logger row 19. Every marker is an actual logger record. Records are connected in chronological order, including unloading, without smoothing. Colored dashed vertical lines mark each stage's first recorded reading; their tooltips identify the source row and time.
